verdict.rationale: Capsule documents managing contacts (lists, filtering, import) and capturing conversations, notes and emails against them, which covers the contact-management core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows company records linked to people or a per-record activity timeline. Missing for 10: documented company records linked to contacts, a per-record activity timeline view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Manage contacts in lists by filtering using your own or using a custom field you have added.
Easily manage contacts, conversations & sales opportunities from within your Outlook inbox.
Forward emails to an email address unique to your account - an easy way to store emails.
